requirements.title: Program-wide credit rules

rule.text: The minor requires 21 credits. At least 12 of the 21 credits must be taken at Stony Brook. At least 9 of the 21 credits must be upper-division.
rule.reason: Program-wide credit totals and an upper-division credit minimum are not covered by the available rule types.

requirements.sourceText: The minor, which requires 21 credits, ... at least twelve of the 21 credits must be taken at Stony Brook. At least 9 of the 21 credits must be upper-division.

policies.sourceText: Courses offered for the minor must be taken for a letter grade.
All courses offered for the minor must be passed with a grade of C or higher. No grade lower than "C" may be applied to the minor
at least twelve of the 21 credits must be taken at Stony Brook.

notes.text: Students interested in history, whether as a major, a minor, a social science course related to their major, or for general liberal arts purposes, are invited to review the History Department website and to seek advice from the Department's director of undergraduate studies and other faculty members. Director of Undergraduate Studies: April Masten.
The minor is organized around a thematic cluster. A final course can be used either to deepen a particular area of interest or explore a new subject.
